results: 1. Bilateral patellar and Achilles deep-tendon reflex examination
deep tendon reflexes and plantar responses: brisk right-sided reflexes with pectoral jerk and positive Hoffman sign
2. Focused lower-extremity neurologic examination, including strength, sensation, coordination, and gait
sensory examination (pinprick, vibration, proprioception): right-sided sensory inattention and astereognosis
coordination examination (limb and truncal): right-sided limb apraxia with myoclonic jerks
gait observation including turning and doorways: not recorded
3. Bilateral knee examination with inspection, range of motion, and ligament-stability maneuvers
